project.name: Bramblecrest support memory
project.description: Shared memory for Bramblecrest's support agents: runbooks plus notes pinned from tickets and agreements.

agents.scribe: scribe-agent pins what yesterday's tickets settled
agents.answer: answer-agent answers customer questions from memory
agents.janitor: retention-job evicts notes whose time-to-live has passed

notes.text: Carrier agreement: Sierra Freight picks up oversized freight from the Reno warehouse on Tuesdays and Fridays only.
Exception agreed with the Alpine Club: club members get a 90-day return window on climbing ropes.
The Reno repair bench is closed for inventory from October 20 to October 24; warranty repairs resume October 27.
notes.really: a notice that is still in the future

notes.text: Gift cards never expire and cannot be redeemed for cash.
Ticket 48213: a delayed kayak delivery to Boise was resolved with a 20 dollar credit.
Ticket 48240: the customer asked whether the Ridgeline 2 tent fits a 6 foot 4 sleeper; the answer was yes.

questions.ask: Which days does the freight carrier pick up oversized items?
Do Alpine Club members get a longer return window on climbing ropes?
When do warranty repairs resume after the repair bench inventory closure?
How long do customers have to return an item?
Can tents be sent with expedited shipping?
